priorityList: Cast two Wraths at 2 seconds on the pull-timer.
Apply and maintain Sunfire and Moonfire.
Use any on-use trinkets and potions.
Cast Celestial Alignment.
Dump Astral Power on Starsurge if using Convoke the Spirits.
Cast Force of Nature.
Cast Convoke the Spirits.
Spend any remaining Dream Surge by casting Wrath.
Cast Starsurge until out of Astral Power and resume regular rotation.
Cast Force of Nature on cooldown to summon Treants and trigger Cenarius' Might.
Maintain Sunfire on the target.
Maintain Moonfire on the target.
Maintain Stellar Flare on the target.
Cast Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune on cooldown.
Cast Convoke the Spirits, ideally while Celestial Alignment or Incarnation is active.
Cast Fury of Elune on cooldown.
Cast Starsurge to prevent Astral Power from capping.
Cast Starsurge to maintain three stacks of Starlord if talented.
Cast Starfire twice to enter Solar Eclipse.
Cast Wrath as your primary filler spell while in Solar Eclipse.
buildName: Keeper of the Grove Single Target Opener
